bibliography.abstract: Kotsila, P., Cuenca, V.-C., Franco, M., Melo, L. and Pickard, S. (2025) EMBODYING AND RESISTING URBAN HEAT INJUSTICE: Migrant Vulnerabilities and Radical Adaptations in El Raval, Barcelona. International Journal of Urban and Regional Research 49.6, 1462–84. https://doi.org/10.1111/1468-2427.13359 The Acknowledgments section in the original submission was incomplete. The following text has been added: ‘Sam Pickard gratefully acknowledges the support of Horizon Europe project Impetus4Change (I4C, grant id. 101081555)’. The full, corrected section reads: We want to thank the participants in this research, who offered their time, energy and valuable thoughts. We also thank the Barcelona City Council and the Biennale event Ciencia i Ciutat organization committee, and especially Dr Helen Cole, for trusting us with the task of moving this research forward. Panagiota Kotsila acknowledges the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities for the Juan de la Cierva—incorporación fellowship (IJC2019-040934) for research support, as well as the Maria de Maeztu Programme for Units of Excellence at ICTA-UAB (CEX2019-000940-M). Sam Pickard gratefully acknowledges the support of Horizon Europe project Impetus4Change (I4C, grant id. 101081555). We are also grateful to Melissa García-Lamarca, Isabelle Anguelovski, Isabela Vera, Beatriz Daunt and Austin Matheney for their insightful comments on previous versions of this article. We apologize for this error.
